title.en: Content is placed in a page, not the shared layout

summary.en: A paragraph or list item of hardcoded content in a shared layout appears on every page and cannot differ; content belongs in a page.

en: A page's words were sitting in the shared layout.
I am moving them into the page, so each page can say its own thing.
fr: Des mots d'une page se trouvaient dans la mise en page commune.
Je les déplace dans la page, pour que chacune dise ce qui lui est propre.

reason.en: Hardcoded content was found in a layout template: a paragraph or list item holding a page's words rather than structure. A layout is shared across pages, so text placed there shows on every one and cannot differ. Move the content into the page or a data file, and leave the layout the structure the pages fill. Structural labels and short text are left alone.
